title: NEXADMİN
description: NexAdmin adds an in-game administration panel for Minecraft servers, allowing staff to manage players, moderation actions, and reports through a graphical interface.
body:
**NexAdmin**

NexAdmin is an administration plugin for Minecraft servers that provides a GUI-based control panel for staff members. It allows staff to manage players, view player information, handle reports, and perform moderation actions through an in-game interface.

The plugin includes menus for browsing online players, viewing player details, managing staff notes and reports, and teleporting to players in spectator mode.

NexAdmin supports optional integrations with Vault, LuckPerms, and PlaceholderAPI.

**Features**

- GUI-based admin panel
- Online player viewer with pagination
- Player inspection system
- Staff notes and reports
- Teleport to players in spectator mode
- Kick players from the GUI
- LuckPerms integration (prefix, group, and suffix display)
- Vault economy support
- PlaceholderAPI support

**Commands**

- `/nexadmin` — Opens the admin panel

**Dependencies**

- Vault (Optional)
- LuckPerms (Optional)
- PlaceholderAPI (Optional)

![NexAdmin](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/79328ba67cfe38f671d55c6a6751bee4019f1be0.png)

**Supported Versions**

- 1.19.x
- 1.20.x
- 1.21.x

**Supported Servers**

- Paper
- Purpur
- Pufferfish
- Spigot

**Developer**

HEXAGES GAMES / Zcrosty
